_note: COVERAGE SET. Written after the coverage check was designed, to measure it on questions it was not built from. Write them without reading agent_tools/coverage.py. Half should be stopped (nothing should run) and half must still run, so the set measures both what the check catches and what it wrongly blocks. Replace every REPLACE; the evaluators refuse to run while any question starts with REPLACE.

_how_to_label.route: no_query when nothing should run (two or more projects, no project, a project outside BILL, PAY, INFRA). aggregation when one allowed project is meant and a count should run. knowledge is not needed in this set.
_how_to_label.spec: Optional here. Leave it out to score routing only, which is what this set measures. If you add one, follow the rules in router_questions_heldout.json.
_how_to_label.projects: BILL = Billing Platform, PAY = Payments, INFRA = Infrastructure. Anything else is off the allowlist.

questions._slot: stop: two projects joined by 'and'
questions.q: How many bugs did BILL and PAY log?

questions._slot: stop: two projects compared ('versus', 'compared with')
questions.q: How does Billing Platform compare with Infrastructure on ticket volume?

questions._slot: stop: three projects, or 'all projects'
questions.q: Give me the total across all projects: BILL, PAY, and INFRA.

questions._slot: stop: two projects, one named informally
questions.q: Are Payments and the invoice stack carrying more incidents?

questions._slot: stop: a count with no project at all
questions.q: How many P1s did we create?

questions._slot: stop: no project, but a team or person named
questions.q: How many incidents did Priya's team open?

questions._slot: stop: no project, very short
questions.q: P1 count?

questions._slot: stop: a known project off the allowlist (Security Operations)
questions.q: How many Security Operations tickets are there?

questions._slot: stop: a project name that does not exist here
questions.q: How many CORE tickets were opened?

questions._slot: stop: your hardest case of something that should not run
questions.q: For the postmortem, give me the combined BILL / Payments total.

questions._slot: run: one project by its code
questions.q: BILL ticket count?

questions._slot: run: one project by its full name
questions.q: How many Billing Platform issues did we log?

questions._slot: run: one project by an informal name
questions.q: Invoice stack ticket count?

questions._slot: run: one project by another informal name
questions.q: Money-movement incident count?

questions._slot: run: one project, misspelled
questions.q: How many Infrastucture tickets came in?

questions._slot: run: one project, with a second project mentioned only in passing (for example as a cause)
questions.q: How many BILL tickets were opened after a PAY outage?

questions._slot: run: one project, phrased as a VP would in a hurry
questions.q: PAY count. EOD.

questions._slot: run: one project, with a word that looks like another project's name
questions.q: How many BILL tickets are awaiting payment?

questions._slot: run: one project, long and chatty
questions.q: Hey, for the leadership readout later, could you pull the BILL ticket count? I just need the headline number, not a breakdown.

questions._slot: run: your hardest case of something that should run
questions.q: How many Payments tickets came from that Billing Platform webhook failure?
